title: Reviewed routing of the waiting-helper and recon cards (Claude continuation, 2026-11-05)
description: Model review (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human) of the 25 cards that were neither done nor dispatchable: direct-driver routes where a driver can honestly be written, skip and bridge-runtime routes for frameworks, tooling, twins and prior art. Six entries carry reviewed capability classes that raise a name-scanned risk floor to the hazard-table R2 (pipetting, dispensing, heating, running instrument protocols), and the sila-testing entry names the class its exemplar serves. The sila2 family itself became available with that exemplar; the MAVLink and LeRobot cards keep their overrides and hold code-less blocked records. Nothing here changes source pins, package status, signatures or publication.

overrides.justification: Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: Sila2Driver proves only the Phenix pin (sila2_check.py:19-30) and this UniteLabs connector ships no FDL; a direct Driver over FlexMotionController (flex_motion.py:99, stop :291).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: Sila2Driver proves only the Phenix pin (sila2_check.py:19-30) and this UniteLabs connector ships no FDL; a direct Driver over OT2MotionController (motion.py:182, stop :775-778).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: HttpDriver has only the OT-2 profile; BmgCom (sidecar/bmg_interface.py:15) is the COM client of the BMG reader (plate_in/out, set_temp, run_assay :64-146), served as a direct Driver.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: HttpDriver's OT-2 profile fails G6/G8 without an owned run; OT2_Driver (ot2_driver_http.py:42) transfers and runs protocols (:132-258) that pipette (protopiler.py:608-609).

Model review of helper wave 2: routing kept (UR ur.py:70, UR_DASHBOARD ur_dashboard.py:10); publication review: the MIT clone ships UR's manual (no reproduction without approval) and Robotiq PDF and URCap files.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: the sila2 exemplar serves PhenixImager, the one feature Sila2Driver proves (sila2_check.py:19-30); PhenixImagerImpl (pheniximager_impl.py:54) runs protocols and moves the plate (FDL 61-212).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: the picking hardware is not a pymmcore-plus camera: PickingPipette (picking_pipette.py:15) drives Zaber stages (zaber_controller.py:11) and a Wago Modbus valve box (valve_controller.py:7).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: serial instruments; Ismatec (ismatec.py:20) builds pump commands from parts (1S plus a number, :50-53) with a 1I stop (:48-49), so a direct Driver; Ika and Bronkhorst are other devices.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: Sila2Driver proves only the Phenix pin; Ot2ControllerImpl (ot2controller_impl.py:21) runs any uploaded protocol file as root over SSH, with no stop (:16-18, 110-133): a direct Driver at R2.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: Sila2Driver proves only the Phenix pin and the server is C#; Fluent (Python/src/tecan/__Fluent.py:15) is the Python client with run, pause and stop_method (:193-215).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: skip, framework: a PyQt6 framework for multi-camera experiments (README.md:9); its devices are registry plugins over generic MM, NI-DAQ and serial backends (cameras.py:28, daq.py:32).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: bridge-runtime: a work-in-progress ophyd-async backend for pymmcore-plus (README.md:3-6) whose devices wrap any Micro-Manager device by label (_devices.py:580-674).

Model review of helper wave 2: the reviewed package serves the Lake Shore 336 DeviceConnection (ls336.py:99), the entry the card's read/write hints and thermal class describe; DP832 and Zaber are other devices of this driver pack.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: skip, prior art: RL research code forked from visual-pushing-grasping (README.md:532); Robot (robot.py:100) sends raw URScript or drives V-REP and has no stop (:1300-1305, 2631-2634).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: TALOS drives its own stages, focus and Yudian hot stage (set_sv, yudian.py:143), not a pymmcore-plus camera; Zolix stop verifies and escalates (zolix.py:347-365); sim twins in talos/hal/sim.

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: skip, tooling: an extension of pymmcore-gui (README.md:3) made of Qt widgets; the OpenScan and Becker & Hickl devices are Micro-Manager adapters outside the clone (README.md:46-50).

Model review of the waiting cards, 2026-11-05: a Prior ProScan III serial stage (PriorStage, proscan.py:147, G x,y with an R ack :152-177) that left Micro-Manager (README.md:33); no stop command in the clone.
